plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: IronPath reads your workouts, heart rate, HRV, sleep and calories (from Apple Watch, Garmin Connect, or any app that writes to Apple Health) to track your training and readiness.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: IronPath can save the food and water you log to Apple Health.

plugins.photosPermission: IronPath uses your photos so you can log meals from pictures you've already taken.
plugins.cameraPermission: IronPath uses the camera so you can snap a photo of your meal to estimate calories and macros.
